input.summary:
flat 2W back room furnished as a kitchen-bedroom: lit campfire hearth on the south wall as focal piece, counter with flower-pot herbs on the east wall, a stair-chair table with a lantern, and a wardrobe on the west wall (parts/room-12.mjs, layers() text).
make.sh gives a whole build.nbt; room check says OK: 40 of 41 floor cells reachable, min light 8, 0 dark cells; no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE for this part.
Rendered room.png and read it: the table, chairs, counter and hearth read; the lane from door (8,5) to the opening (7,11) is clear.
left: No bed: palette.json has no bed block (red_bed etc. are off-palette), so the room reads as a kitchen-sitting room. Add a bed to the palette (joinery or objects) to put one at the south-west corner (foot (5,19,9), head (5,19,10), facing south).
No rug: carpets are not in palette.json either.
plan.md has no checklist ticks for interior rooms; the elements.md 'Light: all rooms >= 8' item is building-wide, so I did not tick it. This room meets it (min 8).
The one floor cell the walk tool marks unreached (5,22,8) is above the table lantern, not a floor cell; the verdict is OK, so it is not a real gap.

waste.what: Drew the furniture grid by hand, then worked out each stairs facing (back side, not front) and the bed head = foot+facing rule by reasoning instead of looking them up.
waste.cost: about 5 minutes and one reasoning pass over the stair convention; no retries of the build.
waste.tool: A `mcd states`-style note in the room plan ("stairs facing = back side") next to the plan grid, or a `layers` legend checker that flags a chair whose back faces the table.

waste.what: Checked palette membership by reading palette.json for each block; no bed or carpet was in it, so the bedroom could not be furnished as designed.
waste.cost: one palette scan; the bedroom plan was dropped after it.
waste.tool: `mcd blocks --check` against the palette before writing the design, so a missing bed type shows up at design time, not in the build.

companions.role: joiner (Schreiner) for the bed and carpet
companions.task: Build the bed and rug the bedroom needs, if palette.json were extended to include red_bed and a carpet role.
Check the table lantern against the dark cells after the palette change; the current light map already has min 8, so this is a confirmation only.
